_comment: Capability -> model bindings for the scanned-book workflow. The graph
records only a capability tier (strong_reader / fast_reader); this file
says what that means for the agent CLI you are driving with, so no vendor
model ID is ever written into .ocr-work run state.
Switch tools with OCR_AGENT_PROFILE=<name> or by editing 'active'.
An empty binding {} means: let the tool use its own default model.
the authoritative task instructions are always the packet prompt built by
